attempts.hypothesis: Pending token count and attention interactions explain model execution costs, while active and waiting request counts explain scheduling and output overhead. Prefix-cache hits may reduce pending-token estimation accuracy.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures per-request scheduling, sampling, and output processing costs.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Estimates token positions requiring model execution, distinguishing prefill from decoding.

pcvs.name: attention_work
pcvs.rationale: Estimates causal attention interactions for pending tokens.

pcvs.name: waiting_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures admission, prefix-cache lookup, and prefill setup costs.

attempts.hypothesis: Most calls follow a linear token-and-request cost model with an additional sampling cost. The extreme residual occurs at the first mixed-sampling prefill; a workload-specific entry-state indicator separates that likely initialization event.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Models the approximately linear per-request decoding and output cost.

pcvs.name: additional_pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Separates additional prefill positions from the baseline one-token cost per active request.

pcvs.name: sampled_requests
pcvs.rationale: Captures extra random-sampling work that can explain differences between equally sized decoding batches.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Isolates the observed costly two-request admission, which is the fixed workload's first batch containing random sampling and may incur lazy initialization. This is a workload-specific proxy.

attempts.hypothesis: Separate prefill and decode regressors should remove systematic decoding underprediction. Random sampling activates batch-wide work, so its decoding cost should scale with total batch size rather than sampled-request count.

pcvs.name: decode_requests
pcvs.rationale: Fits per-request decoding cost independently of prefill token costs.

pcvs.expression: sum((max(0, self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_tokens - self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_computed_tokens) for k in self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests)) if len(self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.waiting) > 0 else 0
pcvs.name: prefill_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Captures pending model tokens during admission and prefill.

pcvs.expression: len(self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests) if len(self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.waiting) == 0 and sum((self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].sampling_params.temperature > 0 for k in self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests)) > 0 else 0
pcvs.name: decode_requests_with_sampling
pcvs.rationale: Models batch-wide sampling overhead whenever at least one decoding request requires random sampling.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Retains the workload-specific proxy for the unusually expensive first mixed-sampling prefill.

attempts.hypothesis: Shared token and request features avoid the fitting failure of disjoint prefill/decode features. Batch-wide sampling extent should explain the residual that sampled-request count missed; positive-baseline regime features test whether sparse feature support contributed to unstable attribution.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Restores the shared request-count feature, which explained most decoding work in iteration 2.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Represents model token work in both prefill and decoding without mutually exclusive regime features.

pcvs.name: sampling_batch_extent
pcvs.rationale: Represents a fixed sampling setup cost plus batch-wide work when random sampling is enabled; the positive baseline avoids a feature supported only on sampling calls.

pcvs.name: admission_regime
pcvs.rationale: Distinguishes the observed costly first mixed-sampling admission using the established workload-specific proxy, with a positive baseline.

attempts.hypothesis: Separate correlated regressors consistently leave sampling and decoding work unexplained. A combined work measure should stabilize attribution while preserving the observed cost ratios; the admission indicator accounts for the isolated initialization event.

pcvs.expression: 6 * sum((max(0, self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_tokens - self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_computed_tokens) for k in self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests)) + 3 * len(self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests) + (len(self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests) + 1) * int(sum((self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].sampling_params.temperature > 0 for k in self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests)) > 0)
pcvs.name: effective_token_work
pcvs.rationale: Combines token execution, per-request overhead, and batch-wide sampling into one integer work measure. Relative weights approximate the observed prefill, greedy-decode, and sampled-decode cost ratios.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Separates the unusually expensive first mixed-sampling prefill using the established workload-specific entry-state proxy.

attempts.hypothesis: The combined feature failed despite matching aggregate cost ratios, suggesting attribution needs separate primitive work dimensions. Retaining raw request and token counts while adding the exact batch-size-by-sampling interaction may explain sampling paths that sampled-request counts and shifted features missed.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Preserves the raw request cardinality needed to explain common per-request work.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Preserves the raw token count that successfully explained most model execution work.

pcvs.name: sampling_batch_size
pcvs.rationale: Measures the entire batch processed by sampling kernels, with exactly zero work for all-greedy batches and no added setup term.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Retains the workload-specific indicator for the isolated expensive first mixed-sampling admission.

attempts.hypothesis: The remaining sampled-decode residual may come from selection work whose extent depends on top-k. Preserve the successful primitive model-work features and replace sampling presence with batch size times maximum top-k.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Explains shared per-request model and output work.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Explains the dominant model execution work across prefill and decoding.

pcvs.name: batch_top_k_extent
pcvs.rationale: Tests whether bounded selection work depends on the batch's largest top-k setting as well as batch size, which sampling presence alone omitted.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Retains the workload-specific proxy for the expensive first mixed-sampling admission.

attempts.hypothesis: Sampling-option predictors explain little additional instruction work. A quadratic batch-size term tests whether the persistent residual instead reflects nonlinear batch processing; retaining raw request and token counts preserves the strongest existing attribution.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Retains the request cardinality that explains substantial per-request work.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains the successful predictor for model token execution.

pcvs.name: request_pairs
pcvs.rationale: Tests nonlinear batch-size effects in execution and sampling that the previous sampling-option features did not explain.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Separates the expensive first mixed-sampling admission using the established workload-specific proxy.

attempts.hypothesis: The quadratic request-count term added little explanatory power. Pending tokens times maximum context length tests attention and padding costs omitted by the successful request-count and token-count features.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Explains shared per-request work.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Explains the dominant token-processing cost.

pcvs.expression: sum((max(0, self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_tokens - self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_computed_tokens) for k in self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests)) * max((self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests[k].num_tokens for k in self.engine_core.engine_core.scheduler.requests), default=0)
pcvs.name: padded_attention_extent
pcvs.rationale: Estimates attention work using pending query tokens and the batch's maximum context length, allowing for padded processing.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Retains the workload-specific proxy for the costly first mixed-sampling admission.

attempts.hypothesis: Decoding consistently has a larger unexplained fraction than prefill. Running-request cardinality may explain decode-specific execution paths that raw total requests and pending tokens cannot distinguish. Unlike iteration 3, this candidate preserves both successful shared predictors.

pcvs.name: active_requests
pcvs.rationale: Retains the strongest predictor for shared per-request work.

pcvs.name: pending_tokens
pcvs.rationale: Retains the strongest predictor for model token processing.

pcvs.name: running_requests
pcvs.rationale: Adds the number of established requests, separating recurring decoding work from newly admitted prefill work while retaining both shared predictors.

pcvs.name: two_request_admission
pcvs.rationale: Retains the workload-specific proxy for the expensive first mixed-sampling admission.
